jars: The app assumes the son 'will not come back I know this' is a settled fact rather than a deep fear, which feels dismissive of her uncertainty.
The phrase 'false affection' in the Ramcharitmanas section is a bit of a theological stretch for a mother-son context.

The 'Go deeper' section suggests sitting with the waiting for five minutes without trying to shape it—this sounds a bit too much like Western mindfulness jargon for a traditional Tamil/English-speaking Boomer principal.
best: You taught two thousand children and you know exactly what a lesson looks like. But this waiting has no shape.
day1_verdict: It finally understood that I am a teacher who is failing at the one lesson that matters to me.
